comment: Independent invent.c mergable() corpse test inside an engulfer. A debug-mode dwarven Valkyrie wishes for two uncursed lichen corpses, creates a hostile dust vortex and waits with m-prefixed searches until it engulfs her, then drops one corpse and then the other. do.c dropz() hands each to steal.c mpickobj(); the second meets the first in the vortex's inventory, and mergable() asks mondata.h is_reviver() of the lichen before stacking them.
